# Object tints

<!-- Generated by `coney-tools refs render` from research/references/tints.yaml. Do not edit. -->

The colours scripts tint world objects with: `ObjSpawn`'s seventh argument, a colour word
`0xRRGGBBAA` (default `0xFFFFFFFF`, no tint), and `ObjColor(object, {r, g, b, a})`. Both end in the
object's tint word ([World objects: tint](../research/objects.md#tint)). The colours scripts give cars
are in [Cars](cars.md#colour) ([Cars: colour](../research/cars.md#colour)).

!!! info "What is complete"

    Every literal tint of `ObjSpawn` and `ObjColor` is listed. No script calls
    `HuSetSpinningIconColor`; its default is listed.

37 entries. Data: `research/references/tints.yaml`.

## Sources and evidence

## Fields

| Field | Type | Hand-written | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | str | | `spawn:<RRGGBBAA>`, `color:<RRGGBBAA>` or `icon:default`. |
| `kind` | str | | `ObjSpawn` tint, `ObjColor` tint or spinning icon colour. |
| `rgba` | str | | The colour word as the object keeps it (`+0xc8`), `RRGGBBAA` hex. |
| `swatch` | str | | A swatch of the colour (rendered). |
| `calls` | int | | Script calls that pass it. |
| `objects` | list | | The object types given it, most often first (at most six). |
| `scripts` | list | | The scripts that pass it (at most six). |
| `source` | str | yes | Where the entry comes from: a script and binding, an address, a chunk. |
| `evidence` | str | yes | How we know: confirmed-code, confirmed-runtime, inferred or speculative ([evidence levels](../guides/research-workflow.md#evidence-levels)). |
| `notes` | str | yes | Our own short notes. |
